name: Roadoff
short: Retro arcade racer: 16 cars, 7 tracks, nitro, drifts, police chases, career.
full:
Roadoff is an arcade racer with the speed and attitude of the classic Java mobile racers, rebuilt for today's phones.

Floor it through 7 locations by day and by night, drift for nitro, jump ramps, dodge traffic and outrun the police. Buy and tune cars in your garage, and work through a career of 36 events across 6 seasons.

MODES AND RACE TYPES
- Career: 6 seasons with a short story each. Earn 1-3 stars per event and prize money for new cars and upgrades.
- Quick Race and Free Drive: pick any car, track, day or night and laps.
- Classic, Versus, Elimination (last place is knocked out), Knockdown (ram rivals with nitro) and Gate Drift.

FEATURES
- 16 original cars across classes D to S, 4 upgrades with 5 levels each and 11 colours
- Seven tracks with day and night looks - coast, jungle, peaks, mesa, alpine, frost isle and neon harbour
- Nitro system with Perfect Nitro and All-In, near-miss bonuses and police Wanted levels
- Jump ramps and barrel-roll ramps
- Pixel-art pseudo-3D graphics at a smooth frame rate, with touch controls made for landscape play
- Watch an optional ad after a race to double your cash
- Works offline

Free to play with ads. Made by Arcadoff.
